question: Should the two open, unrelated attempts for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/105257 be closed together, or should the contributor replace one branch with the actual scheduler fix?
rationale: This PR independently meets the low-signal standard, but repository policy prevents automatically closing one half of a same-author paired open attempt without coordinated handling.

options.title: Close both attempts
options.body: Close this PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105302 together, keep the issue canonical, and invite a fresh focused scheduler PR.

options.title: Replace one branch
options.body: Ask the contributor to close one duplicate attempt and rewrite the other with the actual cron/system-event/heartbeat repair and proof.

recommendation.title: Close both attempts
recommendation.body: Close this PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105302 together, keep the issue canonical, and invite a fresh focused scheduler PR.
